description: The text of raw_b64 is the base64 of a valid BUY frame with one '!' inserted; sha256 is the hash of the valid frame. A permissive decoder skips the '!', gets the valid frame, finds the hash matching and COUNTS the message (slot VALID, six messages). Under 2.2 the text is UNDECODABLE: RAW_HASH_MISMATCH at the line, the message is a replay input with no bytes, MALFORMED (ledger MALFORMED 1, one void): slot NONE; no other finding.
title: an invalid alphabet character inside raw_b64 of a valid BUY frame
